note: Master subject queue for the full autonomous build (~100 worksheets). 12 subjects (4 grades × 3). Build order = the 'order' field; the runner picks the lowest-order subject whose status != done. Each subject's topic arc is designed just-in-time (its first step) against its grade's rubric + concept_ceiling, then locked into that batch's topics.json. Concept ceilings are GRADE-SPECIFIC — do NOT carry G3's loop-centric arc into G1/G2 (their rubrics score loops as out-of-grade).

subjects.subject: Block Coding
subjects.concept_ceiling: sequential + concurrent + REPEATING (loops); blocks only, no typed code. Loop-centric arc.

subjects.subject: Intro Python Turtle
subjects.concept_ceiling: FIRST typed code: forward/left/right, for-loops, simple shapes. THIS is where the block→text bridge (C3-L4 path) belongs. solution.py MODELS the turtle path (no GUI) and asserts the figure — 'executes clean' via the model.

subjects.subject: Debugging
subjects.concept_ceiling: read/alter/fix block OR Turtle code involving repeating events; predict-then-correct. C3.2-heavy.

subjects.subject: Unplugged Computational Thinking
subjects.concept_ceiling: unplugged + symbol/picture only, NO reading-dependent instructions, NO loops/text. Sorting, matching, 'what comes next', decomposition. K-frame (NOT C3).

subjects.subject: Sequencing & Algorithms
subjects.concept_ceiling: daily-routine / directional sequencing, forward/turn arrows, ≤4 steps, picture-driven. K-frame.

subjects.subject: Intro Block Coding
subjects.concept_ceiling: ScratchJr-style symbol-only blocks (arrows), single short sequence, no text. K-frame.

subjects.subject: Block Coding (Sequential Events)
subjects.concept_ceiling: SEQUENTIAL events only — order matters, one actor, ≤6 blocks. NO loops, NO concurrency. C3.1/C3.2 sequential.

subjects.subject: Unplugged Sequencing & Algorithms
subjects.concept_ceiling: unplugged sequences/algorithms, light decodable reading + icons, ≤6 steps. NO loops.

subjects.subject: Intro Debugging
subjects.concept_ceiling: re-order a 3–5 block sequence to fix it (debugging = sequence repair). NO loops. C3.2.

subjects.subject: Block Coding (Concurrent Events)
subjects.concept_ceiling: SEQUENTIAL + CONCURRENT — two scripts/sprites at once, parallel green-flag starts, ≤8 blocks. Loops still OUT (preview only). C3.1/C3.2.

subjects.subject: Events & Parallel Scripts
subjects.concept_ceiling: events + broadcasts + parallel scripts; two things triggered together. NO loops. C3.1.

subjects.subject: Debugging & Reading Code
subjects.concept_ceiling: read concurrent code; find which of two parallel scripts is wrong; predict combined behaviour. NO loops. C3.2.
